summary: This bill renames the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center at 4500 South Lancaster Road in Dallas, Texas, as the Eddie Bernice Johnson VA Medical Center and updates all references to it in federal records.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a purely ceremonial renaming of an existing VA facility with no provisions that authorize, increase, decrease, or otherwise affect any government expenditures.
No provisions in the bill relate to tax policy, rates, credits, or revenue collection.
While the bill concerns a VA medical center, it only changes the facility's name and contains no language altering healthcare delivery, coverage, funding, or policy.
The bill has no connection to firearms regulation or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration-related content or implications appear in the legislation.
The bill does not address reproductive health services or abortion policy.
The legislation renames a veterans' facility but does not alter military budgets, force structure, or defense policy.
No environmental or climate provisions are present.
Although VA benefits are a form of veterans' support, the bill is limited to a name change and does not expand, contract, or modify any benefit programs.
The bill contains no education-related measures.
No references to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or substance-abuse programs.
The legislation does not address sentencing, policing, or criminal-justice reform.
No trade, tariff, or globalization provisions exist.
The bill has no fiscal impact and therefore does not engage with deficit or debt policy.
No provisions concerning LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill does not address foreign assistance or international aid.
No election administration, voting access, or campaign-related content.
The legislation contains no technology, data, or privacy provisions.
No labor, union, or workplace-regulation measures are included.
The bill does not engage with religious exemptions or anti-discrimination policy.
